title: Validation Practice
prompt: Add required, email, length, and pattern validation.

starter.code: <!-- TODO: include required, email, min/max length and pattern constraints. -->

public_tests.name: Static smoke check
public_tests.note: These tokens help triage submissions; they are not a runtime test and should be followed by the human review rubric.

acceptance_criteria: Add required, email, length, and pattern validation.
Keep the solution readable and aligned with the target AngularJS 1.x version.
Include a repeatable normal-case test and a relevant boundary/error/cleanup test.
Use semantic, keyboard-accessible UI where applicable and do not place authorization secrets in the browser.
hints: Start with the smallest behavior named in the prompt and confirm its expected output.
Separate view state from reusable data-access or validation logic when the feature needs it.
Inspect browser console and network evidence; add a regression test after fixing an issue.

retry_policy.guidance: Use progressive hints and resubmit; the platform awards course-wide base XP only after a correct server-graded result. Human review is still required for full acceptance.
